# Error catalog

Error codes are part of the public interface: the CLI maps them to exit codes and prints them in `--json` output, and the MCP tools return them in `structuredContent`. This page is generated from the code (`ERROR_CODES` and `ERROR_CODE_INFO` in `@abox/core`), so it cannot drift. The tools themselves are in the [MCP tool catalog](mcp-catalog.md).

## Exit codes

| Exit code | Meaning                                                                                                             |
| --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 0         | Success.                                                                                                            |
| 1         | Internal error, or a check (`abox doctor`, `abox audit verify`) found problems.                                     |
| 2         | Invalid input; also an unknown id, an operation the backend does not support, or a conflict with the current state. |
| 3         | Denied by policy, approval denied or expired, or a confirmation is missing (use `--yes`).                           |
| 4         | Backend or host unavailable or failed.                                                                              |
| 5         | Timeout.                                                                                                            |

`abox exec` exits with the exit code of the command it ran.

## Error codes

| Code                  | Exit code | Meaning                                                                                                                                                              | Typical hint                                                                                                                  | Returned by |
| --------------------- | --------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------- |
| `invalid_input`       | 2         | A parameter, option or file is malformed, missing or unknown (an MCP tool also rejects parameters it does not have).                                                 | Fix the fields listed in `issues` (or named in the message) and call again.                                                   | CLI, MCP    |
| `template_invalid`    | 2         | A template file does not validate; `issues` carry path, line and column, `details.path` the file.                                                                    | Fix the template (`abox template validate &lt;name&gt;` shows every problem) and try again.                                   | CLI, MCP    |
| `skill_invalid`       | 2         | A skill folder does not validate (front matter, name, size, links); `issues` carry the file in `path` and, for SKILL.md, line and column, `details.path` the folder. | Fix the skill (`abox skill validate &lt;name\|folder&gt;` shows every problem) and try again.                                 | CLI, MCP    |
| `not_found`           | 2         | The sandbox, process, snapshot, template, skill or approval does not exist, or it belongs to someone else (indistinguishable on purpose).                            | Check the id with `abox ls` (MCP: `sandbox_list`); an agent only sees its own sandboxes.                                      | CLI, MCP    |
| `unsupported`         | 2         | The backend or host cannot do this (for example snapshots on a backend without them).                                                                                | Choose another approach or a template with a backend that supports it.                                                        | CLI, MCP    |
| `conflict`            | 2         | The operation clashes with the current state, for example the sandbox is in the wrong state or a human has taken it over (`details.reason: "human_attached"`).       | Wait and retry, or bring the sandbox into the expected state first.                                                           | CLI, MCP    |
| `policy_denied`       | 3         | The policy forbids the request (`details.reasons` lists every reason; deny always wins), or a human-only operation was attempted by an agent.                        | Do not work around it: stay within the limits of the profile, or ask the human to change the policy (`abox policy edit`).     | CLI, MCP    |
| `approval_required`   | 3         | The operation needs a human confirmation that was not given (a CLI command without `--yes` on a non-interactive terminal).                                           | Repeat the command with `--yes`, or run it in a terminal and answer the prompt.                                               | CLI, MCP    |
| `approval_denied`     | 3         | A human denied the approval request, or an identical request was denied recently.                                                                                    | Do not retry the same request; adjust it or ask the human.                                                                    | CLI, MCP    |
| `approval_expired`    | 3         | Nobody decided in time; an undecided approval counts as denied.                                                                                                      | Ask the human to be ready, then repeat the request.                                                                           | CLI, MCP    |
| `untrusted_template`  | 3         | A project template whose current content a human has not approved yet.                                                                                               | Review and approve it (`abox template review &lt;name&gt;`, `abox approvals approve &lt;id&gt;`), or use a built-in template. | CLI, MCP    |
| `backend_error`       | 4         | The backend (container engine, VM, process runner) failed to carry out the operation.                                                                                | Read the message and `abox doctor`; fix the cause and retry.                                                                  | CLI, MCP    |
| `backend_unavailable` | 4         | The backend is not reachable (engine not running, socket not accessible).                                                                                            | Start the container engine and check its socket permissions; `abox doctor` shows details.                                     | CLI, MCP    |
| `host_unreachable`    | 4         | A remote host cannot be reached or does not answer in time.                                                                                                          | Check the host profile and the network (`abox host test &lt;name&gt;`, `abox doctor`).                                        | CLI, MCP    |
| `timeout`             | 5         | The operation ran into its time limit (a command killed by its timeout reports exit code 137).                                                                       | Raise the timeout deliberately, or run the command as a background process and read its logs.                                 | CLI, MCP    |
| `internal`            | 1         | An unexpected failure inside abox; details are logged on the server side, not sent to agents.                                                                        | Run `abox doctor`; if it persists, report the message with the steps to reproduce it.                                         | CLI, MCP    |
| `check_failed`        | 1         | A check (`abox doctor`, `abox audit verify`) ran and found problems; the report is in `details`. Never returned by MCP tools.                                        | Read the report in `details` (or the human output) and fix what it names.                                                     | CLI only    |

A concrete error usually carries a more specific `hint` than the typical one above. `pending_approval` is not an error: it is `ok: false` without `code`, see the [approval flow](mcp.md#approval-flow-for-agents).

## Error envelope

Every failure has the same shape: `abox --json` prints it on stdout, and an MCP tool returns it as `structuredContent` (with `isError: true`). `hint`, `issues` and `details` appear only when there is something to say. The JSON Schema is in [error-envelope.schema.json](error-envelope.schema.json).

| Field              | Type                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | Required               | Description                                                  |
| ------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `ok`               | `false`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | yes                    |                                                              |
| `code`             | `"invalid_input"` or `"template_invalid"` or `"skill_invalid"` or `"not_found"` or `"unsupported"` or `"conflict"` or `"policy_denied"` or `"approval_required"` or `"approval_denied"` or `"approval_expired"` or `"untrusted_template"` or `"backend_error"` or `"backend_unavailable"` or `"host_unreachable"` or `"timeout"` or `"internal"` or `"check_failed"` | yes                    | Stable error code, see docs/errors.md.                       |
| `message`          | string                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | yes                    | Human-readable description of the failure.                   |
| `hint`             | string                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | no                     | Actionable next step.                                        |
| `issues`           | array of object                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | no                     | Field-level problems, when there are some.                   |
| `issues[].path`    | string                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | no                     | Field path, for example `resources.memory`.                  |
| `issues[].line`    | integer (> 0)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | no                     | 1-based line in the source file.                             |
| `issues[].column`  | integer (> 0)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | no                     | 1-based column in the source file.                           |
| `issues[].message` | string                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | yes, within its parent | What is wrong.                                               |
| `details`          | object (values: any)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | no                     | Structured extras, for example `reasons` of a policy denial. |

```json
{
  "ok": false,
  "code": "policy_denied",
  "message": "workspace path /tmp/proj is outside the allowed workspace roots",
  "hint": "Use a path inside one of the allowed roots, or ask the human to change the policy.",
  "details": { "reasons": ["..."] }
}
```
